verses.text: Ix tak'wixi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Wojtak wal sik'lab'il to icha chi' yaji. Palta, ¿tok ay junok onh syal kalanoch ko b'a wach'il t'a yichanh Dios?
K'inalok sko telaj ko b'a yet'ok, malaj am junok tas syal ko pakan t'ay t'a milok tas sk'anb'ej t'ayonh.
Ha Dios te niwan sjelanil yet' spoder. K'inalok sko tek'b'ej ko b'a t'a yichanh, ¿tokwal stechaj ku'uj?
Ha yuj yowal sk'ol Dios tz'ib'xik'e lum niwak witz, tz'el lum k'akap, malaj mach ojtannak tato tzuji juntzanh chi'.
Ayik stzikub'tanhan lum lum tik t'a yet'tal, tz'ib'xi sb'akhnub'al lu'um.
Ha Dios chi' syal yalan t'a k'u to max jawilaj, syalanpax t'a k'e'en k'anal to max yak'laj yok k'e'en.
Malaj junok mach ix kolwaj yet'ok ayik ix yak'anb'at jenhan satcha'anh. Hanheja' pax stek'anem sat ha' mar yik sk'e chulnaj ha'.
A' ixb'o'an juntzanh k'e'en k'anal skuch niwan Osa, k'e'en Oxt'ilanh, k'e'en Mootz yet' juntzanhxo k'e'en yaman yaji scheklaj t'a stojolal sur.
Manhxo b'ischajb'enok tastak satub'tak sk'ulej. Ha juntzanh chi' malaj junok mach syal snachajel yuj.
Tato tzek' Dios t'a ko tz'ey, max yal-laj kilani. Tato tzek' t'a chi' ¿tok snachajel wu'uj?
Tato ay tas syik'ek' t'a junok mach, ¿mach syal skachanoch wa'an? ¿mach syal sk'anb'an t'ay tas sk'ulej?
Tato skot yowal sk'ol Dios chi', max yal yoch wa'an t'a ichnhej ta'. Ha heb' ayoch yet' Rahab ol kan heb' t'a yalanh yuj.
Yuj chi', ¿tas lolonel syal walani yik tzin pakan t'a Dios?
Wach'chom malaj in mul, palta max yal-laj in tak'wi t'ay. In juezal yaji, tzin k'anan yok'elk'olal t'ayin.
K'inalok swawtej Dios chi' b'aj tzin ch'olb'itaji, wach'chom sk'ochi, palta ¿tokwal ol scha yab' tas swala'?
Haxo tz'aji, tzam in yak' lajwok yet' junok ik'nhab' te ow, swach' niwtaj in yahelal tik t'a ichnhej ta'.
Maxtzak xom yal wik'an wip junok rato. Tzam te wach' niwtaj in yahelal tik yuj.
K'inalok swak' pural Dios chi' yik sb'o'an icha tzin nib'ej, max yal-laj yujto haton Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. K'inalok swawtej t'a yichanh heb' juez, ¿mach syal yak'an pural sk'ochi?
K'inalok swala' te wach' in, haxo in lolonel sch'oxaneli to ay in palta'il. K'inalok swala' to malaj jab'ok in palta'il chi', axom Dios tz'alani to manh yelok.
Wach'chom a in tik malaj in mul, palta malaj welk'och t'a yol in sat, maxtzak yal in k'ol pitzan in.
Ha in na'ani, lajanxonhej smasanil. Ha Dios chi' satanel heb' ay smul yet' heb' malaj smul.
K'inalok sjawi chamel t'a yib'anh masanil anima, malaj tas sna Dios chi' ayik slajwiel anima malaj smul.
Skan jun yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk yuj, smakchaj sat heb' juez yuj. Tato manhok Dios sk'ulani, ¿mach sk'ulan jun?
Elanhchamel tzek'b'at in k 'inal, malaj jab'ok tzalajk'olal swila'.
Lajan wal sb'ey in k 'inal tik icha sb'ey junok te' balso t'a sat ha ha', haton te' b'ob'il yet' te' papiro. Lajan pax icha sb'at xumumok nok' ch'akb'a yik syaman schib'ej nok'.
K'inalok sb'atkan in yahelal tik satk'olal wu'uj, tzalajk'olal am tzin ajkani.
Palta masanil in yahelal tik tonhej tzin somchajel yuj, yujto wojtak to max in yal Dios wach'il.
Tato ay in mul yalani, nab'anhej swak' wip walani to wach' in.
Wach'chom tzin b'ik in k'ab' yet' nok' xapon, ma yet' yal ta'anh,
palta ha Dios tzin yak'nhejem t'a skal ha ha' sok'omtak, haxo in pichul sk'ixwi wu'uj.
Max yal in pakan in b'a t'a Dios icha t'a junok komon anima. Max yal walani to syal in b'at yet'ok t'a yichanh heb' juez.
Komonok ay junok mach syal yak'an wil-laj in b'a yet'ok, syalan tas tzonh aj ko chawanhil.
Oktom ay junok mach syal yalan t'ay yik tz'och wa'an yak'anoch in yahelal, tz'och wa'an in xib'tani.
Tato icha chi', maxtzak am in xiw in loloni, yujto malaj in mul icha eyalan tik.
